fields.Name: GitHub
fields.Description: GitHub REST API v3 (2022-11-28) connector. Syncs repositories, issues, issue comments, pull requests, review comments, releases, commits, and workflow runs via PAT, OAuth, or GitHub App authentication.

Configuration.IncrementalSyncDescription: Incremental sync uses the ISO-8601 since query parameter paired with sort=updated&direction=asc and tracks updated_at as the monotonic watermark.

fields.Name: repositories
fields.Description: GitHub repositories accessible to the authenticated user, organization, or GitHub App installation.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Unique numeric GitHub repository ID.

fields.Name: node_id
fields.Description: Global GraphQL node identifier for the repository.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Short repository name without owner prefix.

fields.Name: full_name
fields.Description: Repository owner and name in owner/repo format.

fields.Name: owner_login
fields.Description: Login handle of the user or organization that owns the repository.

fields.Name: private
fields.Description: Whether the repository is private.

fields.Name: fork
fields.Description: Whether the repository is a fork of another repository.

fields.Name: archived
fields.Description: Whether the repository is archived and read-only.

fields.Name: disabled
fields.Description: Whether the repository has been disabled.

fields.Name: description
fields.Description: Repository summary description text.

fields.Name: homepage
fields.Description: External website URL associated with the repository.

fields.Name: html_url
fields.Description: Browser URL for viewing the repository on GitHub.

fields.Name: default_branch
fields.Description: Default Git branch name (for example main or next).

fields.Name: language
fields.Description: Primary programming language detected in the repository.

fields.Name: visibility
fields.Description: Repository visibility level (public, private, or internal).

fields.Name: stargazers_count
fields.Description: Number of users who have starred the repository.

fields.Name: forks_count
fields.Description: Number of forks of the repository.

fields.Name: open_issues_count
fields.Description: Count of open issues and pull requests in the repository.

fields.Name: pushed_at
fields.Description: Timestamp of the most recent Git push to any branch.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the repository was created.

fields.Name: updated_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when repository metadata was last updated.

fields.Name: issues
fields.Description: GitHub repository issues fetched via GET /repos/{full_name}/issues with incremental since support and POST/PATCH write capabilities.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Unique numeric GitHub issue ID across GitHub.

fields.Name: node_id
fields.Description: Global GraphQL node identifier for the issue.

fields.Name: number
fields.Description: Repository-scoped issue number used in URLs and references.

fields.Name: repository_full_name
fields.Description: Full owner/repo name of the parent repository.

fields.Name: title
fields.Description: Title of the GitHub issue.

fields.Name: body
fields.Description: Markdown body content of the issue.

fields.Name: state
fields.Description: Issue lifecycle state (open or closed).

fields.Name: state_reason
fields.Description: Reason the issue was closed (completed, not_planned, or reopened).

fields.Name: author_login
fields.Description: GitHub username of the user who opened the issue.

fields.Name: assignee_login
fields.Description: GitHub username of the primary assigned user.

fields.Name: labels_json
fields.Description: Serialized JSON array of labels attached to the issue.

fields.Name: comments
fields.Description: Total number of comments on the issue.

fields.Name: locked
fields.Description: Whether the issue conversation is locked.

fields.Name: is_pull_request
fields.Description: True when the issue row represents a pull request in GitHub issues API.

fields.Name: html_url
fields.Description: Browser URL for viewing the issue on GitHub.

fields.Name: closed_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the issue was closed, or null if open.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the issue was created.

fields.Name: updated_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the issue was last updated.

fields.Name: issue_comments
fields.Description: Comments on GitHub issues and pull requests fetched via GET /repos/{full_name}/issues/comments with incremental since support.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Unique numeric GitHub issue comment ID.

fields.Name: node_id
fields.Description: Global GraphQL node identifier for the comment.

fields.Name: repository_full_name
fields.Description: Full owner/repo name of the parent repository.

fields.Name: issue_url
fields.Description: API URL of the parent issue or pull request.

fields.Name: author_login
fields.Description: GitHub username of the comment author.

fields.Name: author_association
fields.Description: Relationship of the comment author to the repository (OWNER, MEMBER, CONTRIBUTOR, NONE).

fields.Name: body
fields.Description: Markdown body content of the comment.

fields.Name: html_url
fields.Description: Browser URL for the comment on GitHub.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

fields.Name: updated_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the comment was last edited or updated.

fields.Name: pull_requests
fields.Description: GitHub pull requests fetched via GET /repos/{full_name}/pulls with support for creating and updating pull requests.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Unique numeric GitHub pull request ID.

fields.Name: node_id
fields.Description: Global GraphQL node identifier for the pull request.

fields.Name: number
fields.Description: Repository-scoped pull request number.

fields.Name: repository_full_name
fields.Description: Full owner/repo name of the parent repository.

fields.Name: title
fields.Description: Title of the pull request.

fields.Name: body
fields.Description: Markdown description body of the pull request.

fields.Name: state
fields.Description: Pull request state (open or closed).

fields.Name: draft
fields.Description: Whether the pull request is currently marked as a draft.

fields.Name: merged_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the pull request was merged, or null if unmerged.

fields.Name: merge_commit_sha
fields.Description: Git commit SHA resulting from merging the pull request.

fields.Name: head_ref
fields.Description: Source branch name proposed by the pull request.

fields.Name: head_sha
fields.Description: Git commit SHA at the tip of the source branch.

fields.Name: base_ref
fields.Description: Target branch name into which the pull request merges.

fields.Name: base_sha
fields.Description: Git commit SHA at the base of the target branch.

fields.Name: author_login
fields.Description: GitHub username of the pull request author.

fields.Name: merged_by_login
fields.Description: GitHub username of the user who merged the pull request.

fields.Name: html_url
fields.Description: Browser URL for viewing the pull request on GitHub.

fields.Name: closed_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the pull request was closed.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the pull request was created.

fields.Name: updated_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the pull request was last updated.

fields.Name: pull_request_comments
fields.Description: Diff-anchored code review comments on GitHub pull requests fetched via GET /repos/{full_name}/pulls/comments.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Unique numeric GitHub pull request review comment ID.

fields.Name: node_id
fields.Description: Global GraphQL node identifier for the review comment.

fields.Name: pull_request_review_id
fields.Description: Numeric ID of the parent pull request review.

fields.Name: repository_full_name
fields.Description: Full owner/repo name of the parent repository.

fields.Name: path
fields.Description: Relative file path in the repository that the review comment targets.

fields.Name: commit_id
fields.Description: Git commit SHA to which the review comment applies.

fields.Name: author_login
fields.Description: GitHub username of the reviewer who authored the comment.

fields.Name: body
fields.Description: Markdown body content of the pull request review comment.

fields.Name: html_url
fields.Description: Browser URL for the review comment on GitHub.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the review comment was created.

fields.Name: updated_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the review comment was last updated.

fields.Name: releases
fields.Description: Published and draft GitHub releases fetched per repository via GET /repos/{full_name}/releases.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Unique numeric GitHub release ID.

fields.Name: node_id
fields.Description: Global GraphQL node identifier for the release.

fields.Name: repository_full_name
fields.Description: Full owner/repo name of the parent repository.

fields.Name: tag_name
fields.Description: Git tag name associated with the release.

fields.Name: target_commitish
fields.Description: Branch or commit SHA that the release tag points to.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Human-readable title of the release.

fields.Name: body
fields.Description: Markdown release notes and changelog description.

fields.Name: draft
fields.Description: True if the release is an unpublished draft.

fields.Name: prerelease
fields.Description: True if the release is marked as a pre-release.

fields.Name: author_login
fields.Description: GitHub username of the user who created the release.

fields.Name: html_url
fields.Description: Browser URL for viewing the release on GitHub.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the release record was created.

fields.Name: published_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the release was published.

fields.Name: commits
fields.Description: Git commits on the default branch of each repository fetched via GET /repos/{full_name}/commits with incremental since support.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: 40-character Git commit SHA serving as the primary key.

fields.Name: sha
fields.Description: 40-character hexadecimal Git commit SHA.

fields.Name: node_id
fields.Description: Global GraphQL node identifier for the commit.

fields.Name: repository_full_name
fields.Description: Full owner/repo name of the parent repository.

fields.Name: message
fields.Description: Full Git commit subject and body message.

fields.Name: author_login
fields.Description: GitHub username linked to the commit author, if matched.

fields.Name: author_name
fields.Description: Author display name recorded in the Git commit header.

fields.Name: author_email
fields.Description: Author email address recorded in the Git commit header.

fields.Name: committed_at
fields.Description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the commit was authored/committed.

fields.Name: html_url
fields.Description: Browser URL for viewing the commit diff on GitHub.

fields.Name: workflow_runs
fields.Description: GitHub Actions workflow run executions fetched per repository via GET /repos/{full_name}/actions/runs.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Unique numeric GitHub Actions workflow run ID.

fields.Name: node_id
fields.Description: Global GraphQL node identifier for the workflow run.

fields.Name: workflow_id
fields.Description: Numeric ID of the workflow definition.

fields.Name: repository_full_name
fields.Description: Full owner/repo name of the parent repository.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Display name of the GitHub Actions workflow.

fields.Name: display_title
fields.Description: Commit message or event title displayed for the workflow run.

fields.Name: run_number
fields.Description: Sequential execution number for the workflow.

fields.Name: event
fields.Description: GitHub webhook event that triggered the run (push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch).

fields.Name: status
fields.Description: Execution status of the workflow run (queued, in_progress, completed).

fields.Name: conclusion
fields.Description: Final outcome of the workflow run (success, failure, cancelled, skipped).

fields.Name: head_branch
fields.Description: Branch name that the workflow run executed against.

fields.Name: head_sha
fields.Description: Git commit SHA that the workflow run executed against.

fields.Name: html_url
fields.Description: Browser URL for viewing the workflow run logs on GitHub.

fields.Name: created_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the workflow run was created.

fields.Name: updated_at
fields.Description: Timestamp when the workflow run status last changed.
